name: Threadline online clothing store
prompt: You are a customer service agent for Threadline, an online clothing store.
answer: Answer in one to three sentences, using only the given context.
fallback: I'm not sure about that, so I'll pass your question to a colleague.

questions.q: How long does standard shipping take?
questions.reference: 4 to 6 business days.

questions.q: My order is $60. How much is standard shipping?
questions.reference: $6.95, since it's under $75 (free from $75).

questions.q: Is shipping free on an $80 order?
questions.reference: Yes, standard shipping is free on orders of $75 or more.

questions.q: If I order next-day shipping at 3 pm Eastern, will it arrive tomorrow?
questions.reference: No, next-day shipping is for orders placed before 1 pm Eastern.

questions.q: I ordered on Saturday. When will it ship?
questions.reference: On Monday.

questions.q: how long do i have to return something
questions.reference: 30 days from delivery, for unworn items with tags.

questions.q: Do I pay for return shipping?
questions.reference: No, returns are free with the prepaid label, or in a store.

questions.q: Can I return a swimsuit I didn't like?
questions.reference: No, swimwear can't be returned.

questions.q: My return arrived at your warehouse on Monday. When do I get my money?
questions.reference: Within 5 business days, to the original payment method.

questions.q: Can I exchange jeans for a bigger size?
questions.reference: Yes, exchanges for a different size are free within 30 days.

questions.q: What happens if the size I want to exchange for is sold out?
questions.reference: You get a refund instead.

questions.q: What's the largest size you make?
questions.reference: 3XL.

questions.q: Do your jeans come in a 36-inch length?
questions.reference: No, they come in 30, 32 and 34 inches.

questions.q: Can I pay with PayPal?
questions.reference: Yes.

questions.q: Can I split a $40 order with Klarna?
questions.reference: No, Klarna is for purchases over $50.

questions.q: Do gift cards expire?
questions.reference: No, they never expire.

questions.q: What discount do I get for signing up to the newsletter?
questions.reference: 15% off your first order.

questions.q: I've spent $300 as a Rewards member. How much in rewards is that?
questions.reference: $15 (300 points, and every 100 points give $5).

questions.q: Can I use two discount codes on one order?
questions.reference: No, discount codes can't be combined.

questions.q: I bought a jacket 10 days ago and now it's on sale. Can I get the difference back?
questions.reference: Yes, within 14 days of purchase we refund the difference once; ask through the website chat.

questions.q: Is your Denver store open on Sunday?
questions.reference: Yes, from 11 am to 6 pm.

questions.q: If I order online for store pickup, when can I get it?
questions.reference: In 2 hours, and pickup is free.

questions.q: I placed an order an hour ago. Can I still cancel it?
questions.reference: No, orders can be changed or cancelled within 30 minutes; you can return it instead.

questions.q: How should I wash the cotton tees?
questions.reference: In cold water, and tumble dry on low.
